```go
import "github.com/acme/probe-cli/internal/adapter/outbound/logging"
```

Package logging adapts log/slog to the port.Logger outbound port.

The logger it wraps is the one built by internal/observability, so every record reaches both the console and the OTLP log pipeline, carrying the trace and span id of whatever is running.

<a name="Adapter"></a>
## type Adapter

Adapter implements port.Logger on top of a \*slog.Logger.

```go
type Adapter struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func New

```go
func New(logger *slog.Logger) *Adapter
```

New wraps an slog logger. A nil logger yields a no\-op adapter, so callers never have to guard against one.

<a name="Nop"></a>
### func Nop

```go

```

Nop returns a logger that discards everything.
